text:
devon: Preflight failed for prod app 'llm-serving' during GitOps sync — OPA policy blocked the Helm release. attaching the preflight snip.
infra-bot: policy-check: deny - resourceQuota/gpu-per-customer would be exceeded. proposed change: +2 GPUs to nodepool 'ai-prod' (region: eu-west-1).
devon: ```preflight error:
OPA: violation "gpu-quota-exceeded" at /policies/gpu_quota.rego
resource: aws_eks_node_group.ai-prod count change +2 -> would breach 100-gpu cap
action: deny
```
kevin: We swapped node label in staging last week from `gpu: nvidia` -> `accelerator: a100`. Prod manifest in the PR still references the old pool. Preflight sees a combined plan that would create a new node pool + attach workloads -> triggers quota check.
maria: Could we avoid resizing the prod pool by spinning up a short-lived "burst" pool tied to this rollout? reserved for inference canaries only. lower blast radius and cheaper than permanently increasing prod capacity.
ashley: Policy team will not increase caps without cost approval. We can request a temporary exception for a canary but need a ticket with cost delta.
sam: I ran a quick terraform plan for a burst node group in eu-west-1: `+ module.ai-burst.aws_eks_node_group.ng[0] (count=1)` which adds 2 x a100 (spot). estimated hour cost ~ $0.40/hr, ~ $300/mo if left.
devon: If we add the burst pool, we also need to update the Helm values to set `nodeSelector: accelerator: a100` and proper tolerations. I'll prepare a canary chart and a small routing rule so only 5% traffic hits it.
opsbot: warning: auto-rollback policy active for GitOps sync. If preflight fails >3 attempts, system will revert queued release. current failure count: 1.
kevin: good catch. before we merge: run `gitopsctl preflight --target=prod --policy-checks-only` locally/CI to ensure policy pass. also test `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=a100 -o wide` after burst is provisioned.
maria: :thumbsup: Let's target the maintenance window tonight 22:00 UTC. Sam — can you open the cost approval ticket and tag @policy-team?
sam: Ticket created: INC-8472. Attached terraform plan and rough estimate (~$2k/mo if permanent, ~$20 for a few days burst). linked in the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-8472
ashley: acked. I'll prep a temporary policy exception template and ping @policy-svc for expedited review.
devon: I'll stage the canary in staging with the new label and run the eval harness (latency/cost/regression). will post results in ~30m. :eyes:
infra-bot: note: remember to update GitOps chart values file at `charts/llm-serving/values-prod.yaml` to target `nodePool: ai-burst` for the canary.
kevin: once staging looks good, workflow is: 1) terraform apply module.ai-burst, 2) update gitops PR values -> preflight -> policy check, 3) promote. keeping change scoped avoids raising prod quotas.
ashley: also add a billing alert to the ticket to auto-notify if costs exceed estimate.
devon: leaving this thread open — will post staging eval and the exact values diff shortly. :thumbsup:
